cues.text: Before she’s even out of bed, Maya’s asking ChatGPT, “Does ‘fine’ mean he’s still annoyed?”
By lunch, it’s helping her figure out how to get through a to-do list she’s been avoiding since Monday.
By six, she’s texted the group chat.
“Found us a rooftop for dinner. Under £25!”
Next time the group chat asks where they’re eating, Maya adds one line to her prompt.
“Give me three places and link me to their menus.”
